summary: Join our Labour Leadership and Dispute Resolution training to develop essential skills for effective conflict management and leadership in the workplace.
lede: Labour dispute resolution uses structured processes to address grievances and support constructive negotiations. For labour relations managers and other professionals working with unions, employee representatives and organisational leaders, the course develops skills in dispute analysis, collective bargaining planning and mediation. It also covers investigation workflows, industrial-action response planning and tracking labour-relations outcomes.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals who sit at the intersection of labour relations, workforce management, and organisational leadership. You work directly with unions, employee representatives, line managers, and executives to resolve disputes and maintain employment stability. If you regularly deal with grievances, collective bargaining, disciplinary actions, or industrial action planning, this course gives you structured labour leadership tools to strengthen your impact. This course is designed for: Labour Relations Manager responsible for union engagement and collective bargaining. Human Resources Business Partner overseeing grievances and disciplinary procedures. Employee Relations Specialist managing dispute resolution and workplace investigations. Trade Union Officer leading member representation and negotiation with employers. Operations Manager handling shop-floor disputes and productivity-impacting conflicts. Industrial Relations Advisor supporting labour strategy and dispute interventions. Workplace Mediator facilitating labour-related conflict resolution between parties. Line Manager supervising teams with recurring labour or performance disputes. HR Director setting labour relations policies and oversight of dispute frameworks. Crisis Management Lead coordinating responses to industrial action and labour unrest.
modules: Foundations of Labour Leadership and Relations
Diagnosing Labour Disputes and Conflict Drivers
Grievance Handling, Investigation, and Case Management
Mediation, Arbitration, and Alternative Dispute Resolution
Industrial Action Management and Crisis Response
Strategic Labour Leadership, Metrics, and Roadmapping
prerequisites: You should bring experience handling or supporting workplace disputes, grievances, or union interactions, along with a basic grasp of HR policies and labour relations structures. No coding or advanced analytics are required, but you will benefit from being comfortable working with spreadsheets and digital collaboration tools for dispute tracking and communication planning. Access to anonymised examples of recent labour disputes from your organisation will help you apply course tools directly to your context.
